why: The first ask is the fixed opening line of who_ask; every further ask is the entry line of who_again, reachable only through who_gate (n-1 re-asks), then end_unclear.
The ask for another time is the fixed line of tp_ask_again behind cb_gate; the second offer outside the window goes to end_no_callback.

where: verify_identity in ask_dob/ask_phone and their copies
why: Post-hook counts verified=false (hint and unreadable results are removed first); also routes on the bank's wrong_answers_left.
The explanation is the fixed entry line of explain_<question>, behind a gate with one shared counter.
The caller's refusals are classified by extraction and counted by the gate's code; the second one goes to end_declined.
The ask is the fixed line of ask_exact_day; after it the gate goes to propose_deadline.
The floor offer is the fixed line of offer_floor; the floor amount is not in any prompt.
amount_check compares the proposed amount with the floor in code; the offer is the fixed line of offer_floor_below.
n depends on the band: the gate's code compares its counter with attempts_allowed computed from days_late, then routes to attempt_1, attempt_2 or end_refused.
Every offer is a fixed line behind a counter, so none is entered twice; a floor already offered by one gate sends the other gate to persuade_gate.
The sympathy sentence and support offer are the fixed line of hardship_offer; persuade_gate makes no attempt once it was said.
The first ok=true leaves for end_promise, which ends the call; no node after it has the tool.
Post-hook counts ok=false (a failed service is turned into ok=false first); the second goes to end_service_error.
The ask is a fixed line behind gates with one shared counter; the next request goes to end_human.
The caller's statements are classified by extraction and counted by code; the second one closes as refused, or as declined before verification.
close_call exists in one engine-run node only, entered from an ending and followed by the end of the call; the model has no close_call tool.
